text:
Trevor Connelly scored the winner with 1:42 left in the third period, a snap shot that gave VGK a 2-1 win after the Golden Knights had trailed. Connelly was the 19th pick in the 2024 draft and had spent the 2025-26 season in the AHL with Henderson, putting up 49 points in 46 games. Here he was, 11:18 on the ice and the one who finished it. Braeden Bowman, who was never drafted and worked his way up from Henderson as a free agent, had tied it at 4:20 of the third, 2:18 after Anton Johansson gave DET the lead.

Carter Hart is why VGK were still in it. Our numbers put the quality of chances he faced at 3.03 expected goals, meaning a typical goalie would have let in about three. Hart allowed one, a margin of 2.03 goals saved above expected. DET's best look was a 52% chance for Viktor Arvidsson in the third, and Hart stopped it. VGK owned the first period (1.22 expected goals to 0.38) and led the game 3.6 to 3.03 overall, though DET had the better of the second period and ended up the slightly more deserving side by our simulation, which gave them a 55% chance to win a replay.

Neither team scored on the power play, VGK going 0 for 3 and DET 0 for 2. Daniil Tarasov was solid at the other end, stopping 32 of 34 shots and saving about 0.76 goals more than expected. The record and streak facts for both clubs aren't in our data, so all we can say is that VGK left with the points after trailing late, and DET let one slip.
